compare.appealLetter:
Dear {{worst}} Office of Financial Aid,

Thank you for admitting me and for the aid package you extended. {{worst}} remains my top choice, and I'm writing to respectfully request a review of my award.

After comparing my offers, my net cost at {{worst}} is {{worstNet}} per year, versus {{bestNet}} at {{best}} — a difference of {{difference}}. My family's financial circumstances are unchanged, and this gap makes attending difficult without additional grant or scholarship support.

Would you be able to reconsider my institutional grant aid in light of this comparison? I'm happy to provide any documentation that would help. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
[Your name]
compare.appealNote: Template only — review and personalize before sending. Appeals work best with a specific competing offer and a genuine reason.
compare.appealSubtitle: Cite {{institution}}'s {{amount}} net cost to ask for more aid
compare.bestBanner: <name>{{institution}}</name> is your lowest net cost at <amount>{{amount}}</amount> per year.
compare.description: Line up your award letters to see which offer costs the least out of pocket.
compare.empty: No award letters yet — add them from the Application Concierge to compare offers.
compare.gapped: Gapped by {{amount}}. Even after every grant, loan, and work-study dollar, this much need is left unmet — you'd cover it out of pocket.
compare.loanAsAid: {{amount}} labeled as "aid" is a loan. It's bundled beside gift aid but you repay it with interest — it does not lower true net cost.
compare.netCostNote: Net cost = cost of attendance minus gift aid (grants + scholarships). Loans and work-study are money you repay or earn, not discounts.
compare.noGap: No gap. Offered aid covers your full demonstrated need.
compare.title: Compare Offers

m_adl_wioa.question: Have you visited an American Job Center or been assessed for WIOA?

m_car_childcare.question: Do you need childcare to attend?

m_dis_categories.question: What kind of disability or condition? (select all that apply)

m_fld_nursing.helper: Nurse Corps / HRSA scholarships + loan repayment.

m_fld_public_service.helper: We'll flag PSLF early to shape any borrowing.
m_fld_public_service.question: Is it public service or government?

m_ft_access_programs.question: Are you in TRIO, Upward Bound, or a college-access program?

m_ft_hs_grad_year.question: What year do you graduate high school (or complete your GED)?

m_hom_emergency.question: Do you need emergency funds for basics right now?

m_jus_reentry.question: Are you in — or able to join — a prison-education or reentry program?

m_jus_status.helper: The FAFSA drug-conviction bar was removed and Second Chance Pell is now permanent.
m_jus_status.question: Where are you now?

m_mil_affiliation.helper: This decides whether you use your own benefits or transferred/dependent benefits.
m_mil_affiliation.question: What's the military connection?

m_mil_gi_bill.question: Which GI Bill do you have?

m_mil_rating.helper: A rating can open VR&E (Ch. 31), which sometimes exceeds the GI Bill.
m_mil_rating.question: Do you have a service-connected disability rating?

m_mil_yellow_ribbon.question: Is your school in the Yellow Ribbon program?

m_trb_tribe.helper: Unlocks Tribal higher-ed grants, BIE funding, and Native scholarships.
m_trb_tribe.question: Which Tribe are you enrolled in (or descended from)?

m_und_has_ssn.helper: Either way, we'll focus on state aid and scholarships that don't require citizenship.
m_und_has_ssn.question: Do you have a Social Security number and work authorization (DACA)?

sc_caregiver.question: Are you a parent or primary caregiver?

sc_disability.helper: Can unlock state Vocational Rehab tuition funding and disability scholarships.
sc_disability.question: Do you have a disability or ongoing health condition?

sc_field_specific.question: Is your field nursing, teaching, STEM, or public service?

sc_first_time.question: Are you in high school or heading to college for the first time?

sc_foster_care.question: Were you ever in foster care or a ward of the court?

sc_homeless.question: In the last few years, have you lacked stable housing?

sc_justice.helper: Recent law changes restored broad aid access — most people are surprised they now qualify.
sc_justice.question: Have you ever been involved with the justice system?

sc_military.helper: Military benefits are the richest source of education funding — worth a look.
sc_military.question: Have you, a parent, or a spouse served in the military?

sc_returning_adult.helper: Opens employer, workforce, and short-term-Pell funding.
sc_returning_adult.question: Are you an adult returning to school or changing careers?

sc_tribal.question: Are you an enrolled member of a Tribe or of Native American / Alaska Native descent?

sc_undocumented_daca.question: Would you describe your immigration status as undocumented or DACA?

state_of_residence.question: Which state do you live in?

student_age.helper: Age decides which awards you're eligible for. Under-18 awards are handled for you.
student_age.question: First — how old are you?
